rationale: After a 5-minute bar closes outside the 09:30 range, the broken edge becomes the price where trapped faders get out and late joiners bid; a resting limit there enters the accepted break at a better price with the far side of the range as the natural stop. Losing side: Breakout chasers who paid up at the close and are shaken out on the retest, and faders who cover at the broken edge.

filter.plain: only when the 60-minute trend points the trade's way (the last 60-minute close above its EMA(8) for a long) AND only when the bar that just closed has more volume than the median of the same clock bar over the 14 days before

notes: win_break: the range of the 1-minute bars in [r_start, r_end) (any window of the day) is broken by a tf bar's CLOSE after r_end -> a market entry with the break (follow) or against it (fade), or a limit at the broken edge (retest); one trade a session in the pass of the break
